With the right infrastructure, you can sell your digital products directly while maintaining full control over your revenue and customer data.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

Traditional payment platforms often impose high fees and restrictions, making it difficult for digital creators in countries like Nigeria and Kenya to monetize their work. For instance, Gumroad charges 10% per sale, which can severely cut into your earnings. By leveraging a sovereign commerce infrastructure with NOWPayments, you only pay a 0.5% fee, greatly increasing your profit margin. This infrastructure is designed to function independently of restrictive payment services, ensuring you can operate freely.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To set up your digital storefront, you'll need a few essential tools. Begin with a hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for your website. You'll also require Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic to process orders. Additionally, integrate Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage and Google Drive for file delivery. Finally, create an account with NOWPayments to handle Bitcoin transactions seamlessly. Gather these elements to ensure a smooth deployment.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once your tools are in place, it's time to configure your payment and delivery pipeline. Start by setting up NOWPayments to process Bitcoin transactions. Follow the integration guide in The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) to ensure proper configuration. Next, create an automated delivery system using Google Apps Script, which will send the purchased ebook directly to customers upon payment confirmation. This streamlined process guarantees instant gratification for buyers and reduces your workload.
Retain more earnings with lower transaction fees using NOWPayments.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

With everything set up, you're ready to go live. Update your website with product listings and ensure your payment gateway is operational. Conduct a test transaction to verify that payments are processed correctly and that customers receive their ebooks. This step is crucial to identify any issues before you start marketing your digital products. Once confirmed, you can confidently promote your ebooks and start generating sales.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing initial transactions, focus on scaling your operations. Utilize the insights from The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) to enhance your setup, allowing for additional products and higher sales volumes. Consider leveraging social media and SEO strategies to increase visibility and attract more customers. As your sales grow, you can maintain low fees and complete ownership of your data, ensuring sustainable growth and profitability.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by setting up a sovereign commerce infrastructure. Use GitHub Pages for hosting, integrate NOWPayments for Bitcoin transactions, and utilize Google Apps Script for product delivery. This approach allows you to retain more earnings and have full control over your sales.
Own your infrastructure and data; avoid dependency on restrictive platforms.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.

NOWPayments charges a low fee of 0.5% per transaction, significantly lower than many traditional platforms. This fee structure allows you to retain more of your earnings from sales.

Automate delivery by using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Configure your scripts to send the purchased products to customers immediately after payment confirmation.
